test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

Mohit __have appreciated__ Riya for her hard work.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject "Mohit" is singular, so the verb "have" should be changed to "has" for proper subject-verb agreement.
 
• The correct phrase should be "Mohit has appreciated Riya for her hard work."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part A** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mohit **has appreciated** Riya for her hard work."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Mohit"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "for her hard work."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
